title: 第3552章 从这里钻过去第3551章 就按你说的做
slug: 多子多福这个世界美女太多
content_zh:
李长生的声音不大，周围众人也都是看好戏的心态，一时间没有反应过来。
甚至有人笑出声来：
“哈哈哈哈……”
“还以为这家伙会反抗，长得五大三粗，修为波动也有神帝，没想到却是个软骨头……”
“是啊，不仅没有反抗，甚至还同意了沈青对他的惩罚……”
“这下可真的有好戏看了……”
“不过这也是没有办法的事情，在傀儡宗的地盘，而且沈青的大爷爷还是副宗主。”
“以沈青现在的身份，恐怕就连柳家也不愿意轻易得罪……”
柳青瑶听到周围众人的讨论，脸上满是焦急地看向李长生：
“前辈……”
“你放心，今日有我在，没人敢对你做出任何事情。”
“不就是傀儡宗的生意吗？”
“我柳家不要也罢……”
确实，相比于傀儡宗的生意，柳青瑶更加看重李长生这个人，更加看重自己的伤势和柳家老祖的伤势能不能恢复。
她相信，只要柳家老祖能够恢复痊愈，哪怕只增加一百年的寿元，也能够带领柳家走到更高的程度。
柳青瑶的那些侍女和护卫，也全都露出了一抹同情。
虽然之前那些护卫和李长生发生了一些冲突，但是总体上对他的印象还算不错。
更何况，他们发现，柳青瑶现在的气色确实缓解了很多。
她们不知道柳青瑶体内有丹毒的事情，但是从李长生说出她的症状，再结合后续柳青瑶的反应，这些护卫也能够猜到些什么。
有一名护卫上前一步，沉声开口：

“前辈，我们大不了离开就是，没有必要顺着沈青的话执行……”
李长生嘴角始终挂着笑意，似乎并没有对接下来即将发生的事情感到担心。
沈青方才也是被李长生的话给干懵了。
这样的惩罚，砍断四肢喂狗，从胯下钻过去，摧毁丹田变成废人，只要是个正常人，就绝对不可能同意。
但是李长生同意了……当然了，这是沈青自以为的同意。
随着周围变得嘈杂，沈青也终于回过神来，嘴角浮现出得意的微笑：
“小子……”
“还算你识时务。”
“看在你如此识时务的份上……”
就在此时，不等沈青把话说完，药灵儿直接笑出声来：
“哈哈哈……”
如今她是络腮大汉模样，声音很是粗犷，但是那言谈举止的动作，依旧免不了女子的习惯，看起来倒是非常的反差。
只听药灵儿说道：
“沈青，我想你误会了我大哥话里面的意思。”
content_en:
Li Changsheng's voice was not loud, and everyone around him was also in a good show mentality, and did not react for a while.
Some even laughed out loud:
"Hahahaha..."
"I thought this guy would resist, he's tall and thick, and his cultivation fluctuates like a god emperor, but he turned out to be a weakling..."
"Yes, not only did he not resist, he even agreed to Shen Qing's punishment..."
"This is really a good show..."
"But there is nothing we can do about it. We are in the territory of the Puppet Sect, and Shen Qing's grandfather is still the deputy sect leader."
"With Shen Qing's current status, I'm afraid even the Liu family is not willing to offend easily..."
Liu Qingyao heard the discussion among the people around her and looked at Li Changsheng anxiously:
"Senior..."
"Don't worry, as long as I'm here today, no one will dare to do anything to you."
"Isn't it just the Puppet Sect's business?"
"It doesn't matter if my Liu family doesn't want it..."
Indeed, compared to the Puppet Sect's business, Liu Qingyao valued Li Changsheng more, and her own injuries and whether the Liu family ancestor's injuries could recover.
She believes that as long as the ancestor of the Liu family can recover, even if his life span is only increased by a hundred years, he can lead the Liu family to a higher level.
Liu Qingyao's maids and guards all showed a hint of sympathy.
Although the guards had some conflicts with Li Changsheng before, their overall impression of him was pretty good.
What's more, they found that Liu Qingyao's complexion had indeed eased a lot now.
They didn't know that Liu Qingyao had erysipelas in her body, but based on Li Changsheng's description of her symptoms and Liu Qingyao's subsequent reaction, the guards could guess something.
A guard stepped forward and spoke in a deep voice:
"Senior, the worst we can do is leave. There is no need to follow Shen Qing's words..."
Li Changsheng always had a smile on his lips, and he didn't seem to be worried about what was about to happen next.
Shen Qing was just stunned by Li Changsheng's words.
Such a punishment, cutting off limbs and feeding them to dogs, drilling them under the crotch, destroying the Dantian and turning him into a cripple, is absolutely impossible for a normal person to agree to.
But Li Changsheng agreed... Of course, this was what Shen Qing thought he agreed.
As the surroundings became noisy, Shen Qing finally came back to his senses, with a proud smile on his lips:
"Boy..."
"It's fair to say you know the current affairs."
"Seeing as you are so aware of current affairs..."
At this moment, before Shen Qing could finish speaking, Yao Ling'er laughed out loud:
"Hahaha..."
Now she looks like a burly man with thick cheeks, and her voice is very rough, but her speech and behavior are still unavoidable from the habits of a woman, which looks very contrasting.
Just listen to Yao Ling'er say:
"Shen Qing, I think you misunderstood the meaning of my elder brother's words."
